items.claim: Neil Magny struggles against decent grapplers.
items.quote: If you're a decent grappler, you're a good stylistic matchup against a guy like Neil Magny

items.claim: Brian Ortega is a dangerous grappler and submission artist.
items.quote: Brahimaj is a great grappler, great submission artist... I mean sorry I know it was his last fight but yeah dangerous dude on the feet is Brian Ortega.

items.claim: Neil Magny is a good offensive grappler, middle level striker, and has poor defensive capabilities.
items.quote: He's a good offensive grappler, kind of middle level striker, defensively not the best.

items.claim: Vicente Luque is a crafty submission artist with a nasty darce choke.
items.quote: Vicente Luque is a very very good submission artist. These darts choke is nasty.

items.claim: Trevin Giles is explosive and athletic but not a good fighter overall.
items.quote: Trevin Giles is not a good fighter. He's explosive, he's athletic, he's not a good fighter.
